units.source_text: 斋藤还说，他看见吴清源把探病的客人直送到大门口，举止非常稳重。

en.t: Saito also said that he had seen Wu Qingyuan escort a visiting guest who had come to see the sick man all the way to the front gate, and that his bearing was extremely composed.

units.source_text: 名人的告别赛结束不久，我和吴清源应邀到南伊豆的下贺茂温泉去，听到了一个有关围棋梦的故事。

en.t: Not long after the Master's farewell game ended, Wu Qingyuan and I were invited to Shimogamo Hot Spring in southern Izu, where we heard a story about a dream of go.

units.source_text: 他说在梦里找到了绝着，醒来后还记得一部分着法。

en.t: He said that in the dream he had found a brilliant move, and after waking he still remembered part of the sequence.
